style: Unique hand-painted pickleball illustrations; consistent shield silhouette and rarity-specific materials; transparent PNG exterior; no embedded titles.
coverage: All implemented repository and exported production trophy titles, including nine new round-robin definitions, fourteen division finishes, and eight story trackers. Archived idea spreadsheets and country flags are outside this artwork replacement.

entries.title: Breaking a Sweat
entries.condition: Play 3 matches in a single season
entries.concept: One smiling adult player wiping sweat from their forehead with a towel, holding a green paddle against their chest; one perforated pickleball in front and a quiet sunlit court behind.
entries.people_refresh: Make the central player a Black woman around age 40 with rich deep-brown skin and natural dark curly hair tied back beneath the same orange visor. Give her a recognizably mature adult face, a warm relaxed smile and an everyday athletic build. Keep her orange shirt, green paddle, towel-wiping gesture and the entire composition.

entries.title: Dozen Played
entries.condition: Play 12 matches in a single season
entries.concept: A tidy triangular rack of twelve perforated pickleballs arranged four-three-two-two-one, with a small paddle leaning against it and a single simple medal disc bearing the numeral 12. Only text: 12.

entries.title: Grinder
entries.condition: Play 25 matches in a single season
entries.concept: A worn but cared-for paddle leaning against a stack of practice pickleballs, with a determined hand tightening a wristband beside it; warm sparks of persistence, not a coffee grinder.

entries.title: Ironman
entries.condition: Play 40 matches in a single season
entries.concept: A forged dark iron pickleball paddle with a glowing warm iron heart inset at its center, a perforated ball in front, two sweeping endurance arcs; no superhero branding.

entries.title: Weekend Warrior
entries.condition: Play 5 matches on Saturday and Sunday of a single weekend
entries.concept: A compact calendar with exactly two sunny day tiles, a pair of pickleball paddles leaning against it and one perforated ball; no text or numerals.

entries.title: Comeback Kid
entries.condition: After 7+ days without a match, return and play 3+ matches in the same day
entries.concept: A smiling adult player stepping back onto a sunny court through an open gate, paddle in hand, with one curling return-arrow motif and a bright sunrise.
entries.people_refresh: Make the central player an East Asian man around age 65, with visible short silver-gray hair, natural older-adult facial features and smile lines. Keep the backwards light cap, blue shirt, shorts, paddle, cheerful returning gesture, returning arrow, body position and court-gate composition. He should look like an active recreational senior, with a natural build rather than a youthful bodybuilder.

entries.title: On a Roll
entries.condition: Win 3 matches in a row within a single season
entries.concept: Three perforated pickleballs rolling together up a short curving court line with three gentle success sparkles, and a paddle following their motion.

entries.title: Lucky Seven
entries.condition: Win 7 matches in a row within a single season
entries.concept: One large sculpted numeral 7, a small four-leaf clover tucked against a blue pickleball paddle, and a perforated ball. Only text: 7.

entries.title: Decimator
entries.condition: Win 10 matches in a row within a single season
entries.concept: Ten small bright stars forming a sweeping victory arc over one dramatic paddle smashing a perforated ball across a clean net; use confident sporting energy, no destruction or weapons.

entries.title: Bumpy Road
entries.condition: Lose 4 matches in a row within a single season
entries.concept: A winding court-colored path with four gentle bumps, a determined small pickleball riding along it toward a welcoming paddle and sun; lighthearted perseverance, not a sad injured player.

entries.title: Bounce Back
entries.condition: After losing 5 in a row, win the next match
entries.concept: A perforated pickleball springing from a low point on a curved trajectory toward a glowing paddle, with a bright upward rebound arrow behind it.

entries.title: Stop the Bleed
entries.condition: Break a 3+ match losing streak with a win
entries.concept: A paddle-shaped wooden bridge mending a cracked court line, with a perforated ball rolling from shadow into sunlight and three faded small loss marks turning into one bright star; no blood or medical imagery.

entries.title: Elite 3
entries.condition: End the season Top 3 overall
entries.concept: Three distinct small podium steps together under a bright laurel arch, each with a perforated pickleball and a paddle silhouette; emphasize the whole top-three podium without numbers.

entries.title: Familiar Foe
entries.condition: Play the same opponent 5 times in a season
entries.concept: Two friendly opposing pickleball players recognizing one another across a net, exchanging a cheerful paddle tap; a small circular return motif connects them.

entries.title: Settled the Score
entries.condition: Defeat the same opponent 3 times in a row in a season
entries.concept: A neat scorebook beside a winning paddle and ball, with three bright checkmarks in a row and a balanced scale settling level behind them; no lettering or numbers.

entries.title: Social Butterfly
entries.condition: Win with 8 different partners in a season
entries.concept: A graceful butterfly made from four colorful pickleball paddles, with a perforated ball as its body and a subtle circle of friendly court silhouettes behind.

entries.title: Backstabber
entries.condition: Beat your last partner in the very next match
entries.concept: Two cheerful former partners on opposite sides of a net now facing each other, their paddles crossed playfully above a central ball; a curved swapping arrow behind them, no knives or aggression.

entries.title: Ride or Die
entries.condition: Play 30+ matches with the same partner in a season
entries.concept: Two sturdy pickleball paddles clasped together by one strong nautical knot, a glowing perforated ball and a winding trail of tiny paired footprints behind; loyal partnership, no skeletons.

entries.title: Frequent Host
entries.condition: Play 10+ matches in a season with at least one guest partner
entries.concept: A welcoming guest arriving through an open pickleball court gate while another player offers a spare paddle; one perforated ball and warm hospitality.
entries.people_refresh: Make the foreground host a Latina woman around age 55, with medium warm-brown skin, dark hair with a few natural silver strands tied back, and subtle mature-adult features. Make the arriving smiling guest a Black man around age 35 with deep-brown skin. Keep both people's original clothing, poses, spare-paddle welcome, bag, net, gate and sunlit court composition. Convey a normal friendly local pickleball welcome, with no cultural props or slogans.

entries.title: Back-to-Back Buddies
entries.condition: Win two matches in the same day with the same partner
entries.concept: Two players in friendly back-to-back poses holding their paddles outward with two bright victory stars and one perforated ball between them.
entries.people_refresh: Make the left player a woman around age 60 with light skin, silver-gray curly hair in her ponytail and visible natural smile lines. Make the right player a South Asian man around age 40 with medium-brown skin, dark hair and a short dark beard. Keep their orange and blue shirts, orange visor and backwards cap, poses, paddles, two stars, ball and exact composition. Everyday recreational players, no stereotypes or extra props.

entries.title: Competitive
entries.condition: Win by exactly 2 points
entries.concept: Two paddle heads almost touching over a taut net, a perforated ball balanced in the narrow gap and a tiny caliper-like two-point gap symbol, visually a close contest; no score digits.

entries.title: Thursday Thunder
entries.condition: Play a match on a Thursday
entries.concept: One calendar tile with a bold single lightning bolt above a pickleball paddle and ball, a small warm thundercloud overhead; no day names or letters.

entries.title: Scribe
entries.condition: Cosign 10 matches in the season
entries.concept: A clean open match logbook with a large checkmark, a fountain pen shaped like a paddle handle and a perforated ball resting beside it; no words.

entries.title: Season Champion
entries.condition: Finish #1 overall in the season
entries.concept: A single gold championship cup with a crown floating directly above it, paired paddles and a gold perforated ball, elegant laurels and one solid winners podium; no numerals.

entries.title: Runner-Up
entries.condition: Finish #2 overall in the season
entries.concept: A distinguished silver medal bearing a single numeral 2, two small laurel sprigs, a paddle and perforated ball on a raised second podium step. Only text: 2.

entries.title: Pickler
entries.condition: Opponents finish with exactly 0 points
entries.concept: A playful large pickle standing proudly beside a pickleball paddle and a clean score tile bearing a single numeral 0, with a perforated ball at its base. Only text: 0.

entries.title: Switch Hitters
entries.condition: Alternate partners in 4 consecutive wins
entries.concept: Four differently colored paddle heads arranged in a clockwise rotation around a perforated ball, with two clear curving swap arrows and four small victory stars.

entries.title: Division Dominator
entries.condition: End the season #1 in your division
entries.concept: One crowned pickleball paddle standing on top of a compact tiered division ladder, with a perforated ball, laurel sprig and bright success rays.

entries.title: St. Patrick's Day
entries.condition: Play a match on St. Patrick's Day (March 17)
entries.concept: A perforated pickleball nestled in a large emerald four-leaf clover, a small gold horseshoe and a festive paddle, friendly coastal Irish celebration; no lettering or numerals.

entries.title: Court Sovereign
entries.condition: Finish #1 among the players you faced this season (min 6-player group)
entries.concept: A majestic gold crown hovering over a complete miniature pickleball court, with a royal paddle and perforated ball at the center and two graceful palm-like laurels.

entries.title: Podium Finish
entries.condition: Finish #2 or #3 among the players you faced this season (min 6-player group)
entries.concept: A friendly local-court podium showing the silver and bronze steps together, two paddles raised in celebration and a perforated ball; no numeral labels.

entries.title: Last but not Least
entries.condition: Finish last overall in the season
entries.concept: A beautifully polished wooden spoon held proudly beside a perforated pickleball and a small festive rosette; an affectionate consolatory award, with triumphant warm lighting and no mockery.

entries.title: You got Pickled
entries.condition: Finish last among the players you faced this season (min 6-player group)
entries.concept: A cheerful pickleball peeking out of a pickle jar, a paddle resting against the jar and a small playful consolation rosette; friendly humor and resilience.

entries.title: Upper Division Finish
entries.condition: Finish the season in Upper Division
entries.concept: A pair of stepped platforms ascending toward a sunrise, an upright paddle on the higher step and a perforated ball, optimistic upward-flight motif.

entries.title: Lower Division Finish
entries.condition: Finish the season in Lower Division
entries.concept: A sturdy welcoming basecamp court platform with two paddles, a perforated ball and grounded bronze support blocks, proud reliable foundation.

entries.title: Premier Division Finish
entries.condition: Finish the season in Premier Division
entries.concept: A polished star-shaped silver court crest with a single upright paddle and a perforated ball, refined premier-tier spotlight.

entries.title: Select Division Finish
entries.condition: Finish the season in Select Division
entries.concept: A precise faceted selection diamond cradling a pickleball paddle, a perforated ball and a small checkmark, elegant geometric symmetry.

entries.title: Club Division Finish
entries.condition: Finish the season in Club Division
entries.concept: Two friendly crossed pickleball paddles beneath a welcoming small clubhouse roof, one perforated ball and simple club pennant without lettering.

entries.title: Champion Division Finish
entries.condition: Finish the season in Champion Division
entries.concept: A distinguished trophy cup on a four-step miniature platform with a broad bright crown above and a paddle-and-ball pair at its base.

entries.title: Master Division Finish
entries.condition: Finish the season in Master Division
entries.concept: A carefully balanced ornate paddle and ball above a polished medallion with a small compass-star motif, skilled and composed.

entries.title: Contender Division Finish
entries.condition: Finish the season in Contender Division
entries.concept: An upright pickleball paddle rising through a gentle swooping upward path, a perforated ball and three small rising stars.

entries.title: Challenger Division Finish
entries.condition: Finish the season in Challenger Division
entries.concept: A determined paddle at the beginning of a clear ascending stepped court path, a perforated ball leading the way and a small sunrise.

entries.title: Diamond Division Finish
entries.condition: Finish the season in Diamond Division
entries.concept: One large precision-cut violet diamond above a small pickleball court grid, a paddle and perforated ball below, restrained prismatic light.

entries.title: Platinum Division Finish
entries.condition: Finish the season in Platinum Division
entries.concept: A broad polished platinum ingot with a sunburst engraving behind a pickleball paddle and perforated ball, cool luminous highlights.

entries.title: Gold Division Finish
entries.condition: Finish the season in Gold Division
entries.concept: A warm gold medal suspended by a simple ribbon above a paddle and perforated ball, soft sunburst engraving on the medal with no text.

entries.title: Silver Division Finish
entries.condition: Finish the season in Silver Division
entries.concept: A bright silver medal with a simple wave engraving beside a paddle and perforated ball, balanced cool highlights and welcoming light.

entries.title: Bronze Division Finish
entries.condition: Finish the season in Bronze Division
entries.concept: A durable bronze medal with a small palm-leaf engraving beside a paddle and perforated ball, earthy warm reliable finish.

entries.title: Please, Make Yourselves at Home
entries.condition: Lose with a partner against two guest opponents.
entries.concept: Two home pickleball partners in the foreground with paddles lowered, sharing a rueful but friendly smile after a loss. Across the net two visiting opponents celebrate a friendly paddle high-five, with their guest sports bag beside the court gate. Exactly four adults, sunny court, warm good-natured hospitality, no shame or mockery; central home pair large and readable.
entries.people_refresh: Keep exactly four players in precisely the same roles and positions. Make the foreground home-team man a Black man around age 50 with deep-brown skin, short dark hair and a little gray in his close beard. Make his foreground partner an East Asian woman around age 40 with medium-light skin and dark hair tied back under the orange visor. Keep the visiting background pair recognizably older adults around 60 with light skin and some gray hair, celebrating across the net. Preserve the front pair's gentle rueful smiles after losing, lowered paddles, blue/orange clothing, visiting pair high-five, net and guest bag. No caricatures or other cultural markers.

entries.title: Lucky Charm
entries.concept: Preserve the existing distinctive Lucky Charm holiday artwork, used for both main art and profile badge.

entries.title: Round Robin Champion
entries.condition: Finish first by wins, then points for, with at least 4 players.
entries.concept: A bright individual gold victory rosette with a tiny crown, a paddle and perforated ball, encircled by one smooth rotation arrow; smaller casual-session celebration, no text.

entries.title: Round Robin Runner-Up
entries.condition: Finish second by wins, then points for, with at least 4 players.
entries.concept: A silver second-place rosette with one numeral 2, a paddle and perforated ball, encircled by a gentle rotation arrow. Only text: 2.

entries.title: Wooden Spoon
entries.condition: Finish last in a round robin with at least 3 competing players or teams.
entries.concept: One cheerful polished wooden spoon cradling a perforated pickleball, with a small playful ribbon bow and two tiny confetti stars; warmhearted, no lettering.

entries.title: Mix Master
entries.condition: Win with 4 different partners in one rotating-partner round robin.
entries.concept: Four distinct colorful pickleball paddles fanning outward like a hand of cards around one central perforated ball, with friendly sweeping arrows showing varied partners.

entries.title: Court Captain
entries.condition: Organize a round robin with at least 4 confirmed games and 4 players.
entries.concept: A large organizer clipboard with a simple four-court matchup diagram, a small captain star on its clip, one paddle and a perforated ball; no lettering or numbers.

entries.title: Court Time
entries.condition: Play 3 confirmed games in one round robin.
entries.concept: A friendly analog clock with paddle-shaped hands beside a pair of well-used pickleball shoes and a perforated ball on court; clear time spent playing, no written numbers.

entries.title: Close Call
entries.condition: Win a game by exactly 2 points in a round robin.
entries.concept: A perforated pickleball just clearing the top tape of a net by a tiny gap, flanked by two opposing paddle tips and two bright sparks; a close, fair point.

entries.title: Winning Pair
entries.condition: Win twice with the same partner in one round robin.
entries.concept: Two complementary pickleball paddles leaning together like a high five over two bright victory stars, one perforated ball at their base.

entries.title: Back in It
entries.condition: Win after 2 consecutive losses in a round robin.
entries.concept: A perforated pickleball bouncing up a clear curved comeback path past two subdued small cloud marks into one bright winning star, with an uplifted paddle alongside.

entries.title: Pat gets off the couch
entries.condition: Story mode tracker
entries.concept: One friendly gender-neutral adult with short brown hair getting up from a small cozy couch and reaching eagerly for a pickleball paddle; a perforated ball waiting by the shoes.

entries.title: Pat gets geared up
entries.condition: Story mode tracker
entries.concept: A neatly packed pickleball kit: two athletic shoes, a folded towel, water bottle, paddle and one perforated ball arranged in a simple ready-to-go composition.

entries.title: Pat finds the essentials
entries.condition: Story mode tracker
entries.concept: A friendly adult with short brown hair checking a court bag containing keys, a water bottle and a pickleball paddle, with a small perforated ball perched at the opening.

entries.title: Pat finds the game
entries.condition: Story mode tracker
entries.concept: A friendly adult with short brown hair entering an open pickleball gate toward two welcoming players on a sunny court, paddle raised in greeting.

entries.title: Pat makes it home
entries.condition: Story mode tracker
entries.concept: A friendly tired-but-happy adult with short brown hair arriving at a cozy front door at sunset, pickleball paddle in hand and a warm glowing porch light above.

entries.title: Pat's Laundry
entries.condition: Story mode tracker
entries.concept: A laundry basket filled with colorful court shirts, a clean towel draped over the edge and a small pickleball paddle leaning beside it, with one cheerful soap bubble.

entries.title: Pat's Keys
entries.condition: Story mode tracker
entries.concept: A shiny ring of house keys with a tiny paddle-shaped keychain and a perforated pickleball charm, sparkling clearly against a simple court-colored interior.

entries.title: Pat's Snack Bag
entries.condition: Story mode tracker
entries.concept: An open friendly sports snack bag with a banana, orange slices, a granola bar and water bottle, with a tiny pickleball and paddle charm attached.
